volatility.note: This section does not carry trade recommendations — see the note on the site.
context: VIX 18.44 (-7.75%) — a sharp drop, but still well above the 14.81 reading on Sep 19. Index vol is unwinding last week's chip panic without returning to calm.
Dispersion: AI Memory +4.39% average against Telecom -1.23%. Breadth was 64 of 98 names higher with a median move of +0.63%, so the rebound was real but concentrated in what fell hardest.
Last week's drawdown was large: Micron and SanDisk fell 15% and 18%, and a Reuters headline put the chip-sector loss near $2 trillion. One up day does not retrace that.
Event risk is dense: TSLA and T on Oct 21, FOMC decision Oct 28, MSFT and GOOG also Oct 28, then Q3 GDP and September PCE on Oct 29. Six of 12 favorites report inside two weeks.
September CPI at 3.7% with core at 2.6% both beat expectations. A Fed that stays hawkish into year-end is the macro backdrop for every AI-capex name on the list.
